name: Transportation
description: This suite offers a single room, or series of rooms, typically located near the cockpit or entrance ramp, featuring a number of seats and individual storage, as well as communal refresher stations (one for every 16 seats), to transport a number of humanoids equal to four times the ship’s suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table.
